label: Funding status
definition: How far the money from this source is secured.

label: Capital expenditure, 1st cycle
definition: Capital expenditure of the measure from this source in the 1st cycle, 2028 to 2033, the same period as the 4th cycle of the Water Framework Directive, without operational or maintenance costs. Expenditure before 2028 is not reported. Corresponds to `totalCapitalExpenditure4thCycle` in the Water Framework Directive.
condition: Required if the `implementationPeriod` of the measure overlaps 2028 to 2033; empty otherwise. This field, `totalCapitalExpenditureAfter1stCycle` or both are more than 0

label: Capital expenditure after the 1st cycle
definition: Capital expenditure of the measure from this source from 2034 until the completion of the measure, without operational or maintenance costs. Covers the 2nd and 3rd cycles together, to 2045.
condition: Required if the `implementationPeriod` of the measure ends after 2033; empty otherwise. This field, `totalCapitalExpenditure1stCycle` or both are more than 0

label: Currency
definition: Currency of the capital expenditure in this row, which is in millions of that currency. Euro area Member States use EUR.
condition: Required if an expenditure is given. {ref}`art23-cl-currency`
